name: terrain_lod_scale_table
doc: 8-level LOD distance scaling table for terrain detail

name: ai_slot_array_base
doc: 40×24B AI/aircraft slot records, processed every frame

name: rfm_data_pointer
doc:
Pointer to loaded RFM (Red Flag Mission) AI behavior data. Set by mode_state_dispatch return value.
Copied to cs:word_3B830 by entity_slot_update_loop. Points to 1008-byte AI maneuver data section
embedded within loaded RFM mission files.

name: rfm_ai_behavior_ptr
doc:
Global pointer to RFM AI behavior data, used by 47 functions throughout AI system.
Referenced 4 times in ai_combat_maneuver_selector, indexed by behavior flags to select maneuvers.
Initialized from word_2F677 at runtime, or restored from savegame by farobj_slot_table_copy.
Points to maneuver parameter tables (angles, speeds, G-limits) for enemy AI tactics.

name: rfm_turn_rate_scalar
doc:
RFM-sourced turn rate scaling factor. Used in ai_heading_adjustment_gate to scale
entity turn rate (+0x4C) when updating heading. Multiply-shift pattern: (turn_rate * scalar) >> 8.
Loaded from RFM file, likely difficulty-dependent. Higher values = more aggressive turning.

name: rfm_related_word_3
doc: Related to RFM data, saved/restored with other RFM globals. Purpose unclear.

name: rfm_related_word_4
doc: Related to RFM system, accessed alongside word_2F677. Possibly RFM file size or status flag.

name: global_ground_attack_mode
doc:
Global flag enabling bomber/ground attack AI behavior. Checked by ai_behavior_decision_tree
alongside entity behavior flags to trigger special bomber mode (behavior state 4).

name: behavior_state_code
doc:
Current AI behavior state code set by ai_behavior_decision_tree. Values: 4=bomber, 6=cruise,
7=combat initiated, 8=combat engaged, 9=defensive, 10=target acquired, 11=weapons free, 12=special.

name: behavior_sub_param
doc: Sub-behavior parameter set alongside behavior_state_code. Varies by state (0x00-0xA7).

name: range_threshold_1
doc: Primary engagement range threshold. Set to 0x19C8 (6,600) for cruise/defensive, 0x4D58 (19,800) for combat.

name: range_threshold_2
doc: Secondary engagement range threshold. Set by ai_behavior_decision_tree for specific maneuvers.

name: behavior_angle_param
doc: Angle parameter for behavior maneuvers. Set by ai_behavior_decision_tree (values like 0x2E, 0x8A).

name: behavior_timer
doc: Countdown timer for behavior state transitions. Set by ai_behavior_decision_tree.

name: heading_delta_timer
doc:
Timer for heading delta monitoring (ai_heading_delta_monitor). Reset to 0x1E0 (480 frames) when
heading delta exceeds 25°. Used to throttle event triggering.

name: view_temp_record
doc: Temporary view record for 3D projection calculations

name: view_horizontal_angle
doc: Camera horizontal angle (yaw)

name: view_vertical_angle
doc: Camera vertical angle (pitch)

name: view_h_direction
doc: Horizontal direction flag (0=left, 1=right)

name: view_v_direction
doc: Vertical direction flag (0=down, 1=up)

name: view_mode_attribute
doc: Current view mode/attribute index for rendering

name: audio_sbi_mode
doc: SBI mode flag (0=OPL2/AdLib, 1=SoundBlaster)

name: audio_channel_limit
doc: Maximum number of simultaneous audio channels

name: audio_opl_register_table
doc: OPL2 register table (2 bytes per entry)

name: audio_sb_register_table
doc: SoundBlaster register table (2 bytes per entry)

name: entity_slot_records
doc: 16×92B active entity slots at segment 0x54AF

name: entity_type_class_table
doc: Entity type→class mapping table

name: entity_filename_buffer
doc: Entity type filename buffer (e.g., 'F4', 'SA', 'MIG29')

name: weapon_name_table
doc:
Weapon name string table for loadout display. Contains null-terminated weapon names:
AIM9P, AIM9M, AIM120 (A-A missiles), AGM88, AGM65B, AGM65D, AGM45 (A-G missiles),
MK82HD (bombs), CBU84 (cluster), GBU15 (guided), AGM84 (Harpoon). Accessed by offset
calculation from weapon type ID. No direct xrefs - indexed dynamically by menu system.

name: weapon_game_mode
doc: Game mode flag (0=normal combat, 1+=restricted fire modes)

name: weapon_friendly_fire_flags
doc: Friendly fire permission flags

name: weapon_queue_head
doc:
Pointer to current weapon queue entry (27-byte stride). Advanced by 0x1B after each processed weapon.
Queue holds weapon spawn requests waiting for type dispatch and entity allocation.

name: weapon_queue_count
doc: Number of pending weapon spawn requests in queue. Decremented as weapons are processed.

name: weapon_processed_count
doc: Counter of weapons processed since last reset. Incremented after each weapon initialization.

name: weapon_spawn_value
doc:
Value loaded during weapon spawn (stored at weapon+0x18). Purpose unclear - may be timestamp,
spawn sequence ID, or configuration index.

name: weapon_ammo_count
doc:
Current ammunition count for selected weapon. Max 0x80 (128 rounds). When at max, flag 0x1000
is set during burst fire. Decremented per projectile in burst.

name: ag_weapon_queue_head
doc:
Pointer to current A-G weapon queue entry (41-byte stride, 0x29). Advanced after each processed
A-G weapon. Separate from main weapon queue (27-byte stride). Handles weapon types 0x14-0x32
including AGM-88 HARM (0x19), Maverick variants, and bombs/rockets.

name: ag_weapon_queue_count
doc:
Number of pending A-G weapon spawn requests in queue. Decremented as A-G weapons are processed
by ag_weapon_entity_initialize dispatcher. Independent from weapon_queue_count.

name: target_scan_mode_flag
doc:
Target scanning mode flag. Checked by target_cycle_scan @ 0x48B05 to determine if target
cycling is active. 0 = inactive, non-zero = active scanning enabled.

name: target_cycle_timer
doc:
Target cycle timer/counter. Decremented each frame in target_cycle_scan @ 0x48B05.
When reaches 0, resets to 0 and reverses cycle direction (byte_5948E negated).

name: target_cycle_direction
doc:
Target cycle direction flag (-1, 0, +1). Controls forward/backward scanning through
entity table. Negated when target_cycle_timer reaches 0 to reverse scan direction.

name: target_previous_or_alternate
doc:
Previous or alternate target entity index. Used for target memory/cycling between
multiple valid targets. Value 0xFFFF = no previous target.

name: target_current_selected
doc:
Current selected target entity index. Points to entity in table at offset 0x1734h.
Value 0xFFFF = no target currently selected. Primary target tracking variable.

name: target_maximum_count
doc:
Maximum target count or entity array boundary. Used by target_cycle_scan @ 0x48B05
to limit scanning range. Compared with BX register during entity iteration.

name: target_data_pointer
doc:
Pointer to target data structure. Passed to undoc_48C20 for target processing.
Used for HUD display and weapon designation.

name: target_related_flag
doc:
Target-related flag or counter. Initialized to 0 (BX register) at start of
target_cycle_scan. Purpose unclear - may track scan state or target validity.

name: target_type_selector
doc:
Current target type selector or index. Used to index into entity field table
at offset +0x487Eh, then added to SI to access entity field at +0xAEh.
Compared with value 2 for special case handling.

name: entity_slot_index_base
doc:
Base index for entity slot array calculations. Used by r12_farptr_load_thunk @ 0x41B32.
Subtracted from slot index before multiplication by stride (0x5C=92 bytes).
Formula: byte_offset = (index - entity_slot_index_base) * 0x5C

name: weapon_damage_scale
doc:
Damage scale multiplier used in impact calculation by store_impact_step @ 0x39889.
Multiplied with weapon field [si+14h], then shifted and stored back.

name: entity_table_base_offset
doc:
Entity table base offset for index validation in store_impact_step @ 0x3980A.
Subtracted from target_slot_index before calling entity_record_table_ops.

name: entity_dispatch_table
doc:
Entity function dispatch table indexed by object_category field (+0x0C).
20 word entries, each is offset from code segment base 0x3B830.
Dispatched by entity_slot_update_loop @ 0x3C25D-0x3C261.
Category mappings: 1=PLAYER_AIRCRAFT, 2=AI_FIGHTER, 3=AI_BOMBER, 4=BUILDING,
7=GROUND_VEHICLE, 9-14,19=PROJECTILES. Each category has specialized update function.

name: ir_lock_target_index
doc:
Current IR lock target index or lock state. Values 0-3 in mode 0 (simple), 4-16 in mode 1 (extended).
Read/written multiple times per frame during lock search. When stable, IR lock is acquired.

name: ir_lock_cycle_index_mode0
doc:
IR lock cycle counter for mode 0 (simple search). Values 0-3, cycles through 4 potential targets.
Incremented each frame with (ax+1) & 3 pattern until valid heat signature found.

name: ir_lock_cycle_index_mode1
doc:
IR lock cycle counter for mode 1 (extended search). Values 4-16 (0x4-0x10), wider search range
for 13 potential targets. Wraps: if > 16, reset to 4.

name: ir_lock_status_byte
doc:
IR lock status gate condition. Compared to high byte of lock index before checking entity
heat signature. Exact semantics unclear, likely enables/disables IR seeker.

name: ir_lock_entity_base
doc:
Pointer to entity base for IR lock checks. Loaded into SI, used as base for entity field access
at [bx+si+0xAE] to check heat_signature field.

name: ir_lock_slot_mapping
doc:
Entity slot index mapping array. Indexed by lock cycle value to get actual entity slot ID.
Translates lock index (0-15) → entity slot for heat signature check.

name: ir_lock_temp_byte_1075
doc: Cleared to 0 at IR lock function entry. Temporary variable, purpose unclear.

name: ir_lock_temp_byte_44d4
doc: Cleared to 0 at IR lock function entry. Temporary variable, purpose unclear.

name: ir_lock_temp_byte_499e
doc: Cleared to 0 at IR lock function entry. Temporary variable, purpose unclear.

name: coord_world_offset_x
doc: World position offsets (3×word for X, Y, Z)

doc: Current menu ID

name: loadout_fuel_capacity

name: loadout_drag_coefficient

name: loadout_hardpoint_config

name: loadout_weapon_supply

doc: Far pointer to loadout/armament data structure

name: entity_aircraft_array_ptr

name: input_scan_code_queue
doc: Current keyboard scan code from input queue (1=ESC, 3=exit, 0xFF=special)

name: input_device_calibration_flag
doc: Input device calibration flag, 0xFF=enabled, 0x00=disabled

name: keyboard_event_gate_flag

name: hud_text_line_counter
doc: HUD text rendering line counter, incremented per line

name: ui_transition_frame_counter

name: campaign_file_operation_flag
doc: Campaign file operation gate flag, controls temp save file access

name: current_view_index
doc: Current menu state/view index (0-6), controls R57 state machine dispatch

name: menu_input_command_byte
doc: Input/command byte for menu navigation (checked for '2', '4', '6' keys)

name: menu_temp_accumulator
doc: Temporary accumulator for sum calculations in State 0

name: menu_flight_record_sum
doc: Sum of flight record byte_4 values from 0 to current_flight_index

name: menu_ui_field_index
doc: UI field/button selection index (used in State 6 for array indexing)

name: menu_ui_mode_config
doc: UI mode configuration flag (set to 4 in default render case)

name: menu_cursor_coord_y
doc: Menu cursor Y coordinate (checked against regions 0x86, 0x76, 0xB6, 0x9E in State 6)

name: menu_flag_byte_7a302
doc: Menu state flag checked in State 0 before display handler call

name: menu_flag_byte_7a30e
doc: Menu state flag checked in State 0 before display handler call

name: menu_init_flag_79b60
doc: Menu initialization flag (cleared to 0 on state machine entry)

name: menu_init_flag_79e86
doc: Menu initialization flag (cleared to 0 on state machine entry)

name: menu_loadout_array_ptr
doc: Far pointer to loadout configuration array (23-byte stride), indexed by flight record sum

name: menu_coordinate_data_ptr
doc: Far pointer to coordinate data structure (used in ui_coordinate_transform)

name: menu_data_ptr_79e68
doc: Far pointer to menu data structure (set to 4FC2:0600 in State 0 and State 4)

name: menu_data_structure_ptr
doc: Far pointer to data structure with offsets (modified in State 2, +0=dword, +0x24=word, +0x26=word)

name: menu_validation_threshold
doc: Validation threshold for menu_flight_record_sum comparison (State 2)

name: radar_mode_state
doc: Primary radar mode state variable. 0=search inactive, 1=NAM (Normal Air Mode),  2=SAM (Situation Awareness Mode / intermediate tracking), 3=ACM (Air Combat Maneuvering),  4=disabled/invalid, 5=STT (Single Target Track / locked). Set by r06_mode_step_dispatch  based on F5/F6/F7 keys in HFR mode. Checked by mode_stream_select_step and 27 other functions.

name: radar_type_selector
doc: Radar type configuration selector. Values: 0=SAD (Situation Awareness Display, 360° arcade),  1=SAM (120° cone intermediate), 2=HFR (High Fidelity Radar, realistic manual control with submodes).  Loaded from config segment 706Eh offset +0x14, transformed as -(config_value - 2).  Gates F5/F6/F7 functionality: submodes only work when value=2 (HFR mode).  When <=1, mode_stream_select_step jumps to steerpoint_scan_update instead of target tracking.

name: radar_selected_target_index
doc: Index of currently selected radar target in entity array (stride=4). Value 0xFFFF means no target selected.  Used by mode_stream_select_step to cycle through targets with F6 ACM stepping.  Wraps at boundary 0x40 (16 entities). Set by target scanning loop, cleared by floor_bounds_set_9f.

name: radar_target_x_coordinate
doc: Selected target X position (world coordinates), copied from entity +0x96h field

name: radar_display_x_adjusted
doc: Display X coordinate adjusted for altitude perspective. Computed as  ((target_alt - ref_alt) * 1584 + target_x). Must be in range [96, 226] for valid display.  Used by undoc_39D02 to position radar target indicator.

name: radar_target_y_coordinate
doc: Selected target Y position (world coordinates), copied from entity +0x98h field

name: radar_display_bounds_left
doc: Left bound of radar display indicator region (computed by undoc_39D02)

name: radar_display_bounds_right
doc: Right bound of radar display indicator region (computed by undoc_39D02)

name: radar_display_center_offset
doc: Center offset for radar display positioning (computed by undoc_39D02)

name: radar_mode_flag
doc: Radar mode flag, cleared to 0 by r06_mode_step_dispatch on mode entry

name: radar_state_flag
doc: Radar state flag, set to 3 by r06_mode_step_dispatch in both HFR and non-HFR paths

name: radar_active_flag
doc: Radar active flag, set to 1 by r06_mode_step_dispatch on radar initialization

name: radar_param_byte
doc: Radar parameter byte, set to 2 by r06_mode_step_dispatch in non-HFR path

name: radar_submode_flag
doc: Radar submode flag, cleared to 0 by r06_mode_step_dispatch in HFR path

name: radar_display_mode_flag
doc: Display mode flag (0/1/2) that affects scaling in undoc_39D02 coordinate calculations

name: radar_temp_flag
doc: Temporary flag cleared to 0 by mode_stream_select_step at start of target scan

name: radar_entity_array_scale
doc: Entity array scaling factor. Multiplied by 4 and used for self-modifying code patches  in mode_stream_select_step to set dynamic entity array boundary (default 0x4444).

name: radar_reference_altitude_ptr
doc: Pointer to reference altitude structure. Offset +0x0C contains altitude value  subtracted from target altitude for perspective calculation in mode_stream_select_step.

name: radar_state_word
doc: Radar state word, set to 0xFFFF (cleared target) by r06_mode_step_dispatch

name: radar_config_byte_related
doc: Configuration byte loaded from segment 706Eh offset +0x0C by record_script_coord_entry.  Related to radar_type_selector but separate config parameter.

name: radar_config_flag_1
doc: Configuration flag, set to 0 or 2 by record_script_coord_entry based on  radar_config_byte_related value. Set to 2 when radar_config_byte_related is 0.

name: radar_config_flag_2
doc: Configuration flag, set to 0 or 4 by record_script_coord_entry based on  radar_config_byte_related value. Set to 4 when radar_config_byte_related is 0.

name: radar_range_max
doc: Maximum detection range threshold (game units). Set by F8 key handler based on  selected range mode (10/20/40/80 nm). Used by bound_range_check_4aad to determine  if target is within radar range. Compared against entity.range field (+0x92).

name: radar_range_min
doc: Minimum detection range threshold (game units). Set by F8 key handler.  Targets closer than this are out of detection bounds. Used with radar_range_max  to define the detection band for current F8 setting.

name: detection_mode_state
doc: Detection state machine mode variable. Checked for values 1 and 2 by  bound_range_check_4aad. Value 2 triggers RADAR_VISIBLE flag setting.  Part of complex state machine that gates detection logic.

name: detection_gate_flag
doc: Detection enable gate flag. When set to 1, bypasses certain detection checks  and allows RADAR_VISIBLE flag to be set. Used by bound_range_check_4aad.

name: detection_state_flag_1
doc: Detection state machine flag. Cleared to 0 when entering certain detection states  in bound_range_check_4aad. Part of multi-flag state tracking system.

name: detection_state_flag_2
doc: Detection state machine flag. Cleared to 0 alongside detection_state_flag_1.  Read and written by detection logic to track state transitions.

name: detection_state_flag_3
doc: Detection state machine flag. Cleared to 0 when RADAR_VISIBLE flag is cleared.  Used in detection enable/disable logic.

name: detection_state_flag_4
doc: Detection state machine flag. Set to 1 under specific detection conditions.  Part of timer/threshold state management at 0x3AAB8 in bound_range_check_4aad.

name: detection_timer
doc: Detection timer/counter. Compared against cs:word_2F679 and modified during  detection state transitions. Set to 0xA00 (2560) under certain conditions.

name: detection_threshold
doc: Detection threshold value. Set to 0xA00 (2560) by detection logic at 0x3AABD.  Used in conjunction with detection_timer for time-based state management.

name: map_pos_x
comment: Current player/camera map position X (0..31 in 32x32 active elevation grid, bias 0x3400, divisor 0xCCD0).

name: map_pos_y
comment: Current player/camera map position Y (0..31 in 32x32 active elevation grid, bias 0x3400, divisor 0xCCD0).

name: tactical_map_buffer_ptr
comment: Far pointer to 2D tactical map background raster buffer (4-byte header: width=240, height=200, followed by 48,000 bytes palette indices). Loaded by undoc_133535 from .MAP file; displayed up to 20x zoom in 2D tactical planning screen; never accessed by 3D flight engine.

name: isldat_gridb_quad_off
comment: Offset to current quadrant coarse Grid B in ISLDAT (4 quadrants of 16x16 cells = 1024 bytes, 0x000..0x400).

name: isldat_grida_quad_off
comment: Offset to current quadrant fine Grid A in ISLDAT (4 quadrants of 8x8 cells = 256 bytes, 0x400..0x500).

name: terrain_tessellation_mode
doc: Terrain mesh tessellation mode (opcode bits 9..11). 0=none, 4=midpoint, 6=triangle split, 8=hierarchical.

name: raster_shading_mode_flag
doc: Rasterizer shading mode flag (opcode bit 15). 0x00=flat solid span fill (loc_88247), 0x80=pseudo-Gouraud 8x8 ordered dither scanline shading (loc_882D3).

name: slot3_alt_file_handle
doc: File or EMS handle for theater altitude block stream in slot3.

name: streaming_tile_center_y
doc: Current center tile Y coordinate for 3x3 active tile streaming ring.

name: streaming_tile_center_x
doc: Current center tile X coordinate for 3x3 active tile streaming ring.
